title: What today's consumers want from skin and sun care
summary: Today's beauty consumers expect more from their skin care and sun care products. Beyond visible results, they want products that feel good on the skin and align with their sustainability priorities. For beauty brands, meeting these expectations presents an opportunity to differentiate in a competitive market
